summary: List the objects under one prefix of one bucket.

prefix.describe: the key prefix; policy narrows it with a prefix constraint. Required so the flag never dangles; may be empty.

layer2.enforced_by: IAM: the access key in the vault belongs to a user or role whose policy allows s3:ListBucket on the named buckets and nothing else. Tower stage 1 for AWS replaces the stored key with an STS session per operation; until then the vault holds it.
layer2.check: aws s3api put-object --bucket <b> --key x --body /dev/null  ->  AccessDenied; aws iam list-users  ->  AccessDenied
